definitions.explanation: A legal entity organized for the purpose of generating profit for its owners or shareholders. Includes stock companies, limited liability companies, and other business entities in Japanese law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}→株式会社：19101_kabushikigaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{営利法人|えいりほうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な⟦{形態|けいたい}→形態：12558_keitai⟧だ。
examples.english: A stock company is a representative form of for-profit corporation.

examples.japanese: {営利法人|えいりほうじん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{非営利法人|ひえいりほうじん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{税制|ぜいせい}→税制：28854_zeisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: For-profit corporations and non-profit organizations are taxed differently.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{営利法人|えいりほうじん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、NPO⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{運営|うんえい}する→運営する：21987_uneisuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{検討中|けんとうちゅう}→検討中：08718_kentouchuu⟧だ。
examples.english: We are considering whether to establish this venture as a for-profit corporation or operate it as an NPO.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{営利|えいり}→営利：23144_eiri⟧ (profit-making, commercial) and ⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧ (legal entity, corporation). A standard legal and business term that appears in corporate law, tax discussions, and business planning.

USAGE:
In Japanese law, ⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧ (legal entities) are classified as either ⟦{営利|えいり}→営利：23144_eiri⟧ (for-profit) or ⟦{非営利|ひえいり}→非営利：19298_hieiri⟧ (non-profit). The main types of {営利法人|えいりほうじん} are ⟦{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}→株式会社：19101_kabushikigaisha⟧ (stock companies) and {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ} (limited liability companies).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {営利法人|えいりほうじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧: to establish a for-profit corporation
- {営利法人|えいりほうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{税制|ぜいせい}→税制：28854_zeisei⟧: taxation of for-profit corporations
- {営利法人|えいりほうじん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to register as a for-profit corporation
- {営利法人|えいりほうじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形態|けいたい}→形態：12558_keitai⟧: type of for-profit corporation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {非営利法人|ひえいりほうじん}: non-profit organization — a legal entity that does not distribute profits to members
- ⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧: legal entity, corporation — the broader category encompassing both for-profit and non-profit entities
- ⟦{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}→株式会社：19101_kabushikigaisha⟧: stock company — the most common type of for-profit corporation in Japan
- {営利目的|えいりもくてき}: for commercial purposes — describes the profit-seeking intent behind an activity
